# 🧠 LLM Hallucination Detection — Machine Learning Benchmark

![Kaggle](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kaggle-Dataset-20BEFF)

## 🔍 Overview / Visão Geral <a name="overview"></a>

**EN:** This project applies supervised Machine Learning to automatically detect hallucinations in responses generated by six leading LLMs: GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama 3, Mistral and Gemma. The dataset contains 25,200 rows across three high-stakes domains: Technology & AI, Science & Biology, and Medicine & Health.

**PT:** Este projeto aplica Machine Learning supervisionado para detectar automaticamente alucinações em respostas geradas por seis LLMs: GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama 3, Mistral e Gemma. O dataset contém 25.200 linhas em três domínios de alto risco: Tecnologia & IA, Ciência & Biologia e Medicina & Saúde.

## 💼 Business Problem / Problema de Negócio <a name="business-problem"></a>

**EN:**
> How can we build a Machine Learning model capable of automatically detecting whether a response generated by an LLM contains a hallucination — before that response reaches the end user?

**PT:**
> Como construir um modelo de Machine Learning capaz de detectar automaticamente se uma resposta gerada por um LLM contém alucinação — antes que essa resposta chegue ao usuário final?

### Business Value / Valor de Negócio

| EN | PT |
|---|---|
| Automatically flag high-risk responses | Sinalizar respostas de alto risco automaticamente |
| Reduce costly human annotation | Reduzir anotação humana cara |
| Enable smarter model routing | Habilitar roteamento inteligente de modelos |
| Deployable as a hallucination risk API | Implantável como API de risco de alucinação |
| Support AI safety research | Apoiar pesquisa de segurança em IA |

## 📊 Dataset <a name="dataset"></a>

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Source | [Kaggle — LLM Hallucination Benchmark v2](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/hussnainmamoon1/llm-hallucination-benchmark-v2) |
| Rows | 25,200 |
| Columns | 23 |
| Models | GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma |
| Domains | Technology & AI, Science & Biology, Medicine & Health |
| Difficulty | easy, medium, hard |
| License | CC BY-SA 4.0 |

### Hallucination Rates by Model / Taxas de Alucinação por Modelo

| Model | Type | Hallucination Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Claude | Closed-source | ~14.7% |
| GPT-4o | Closed-source | ~17.9% |
| Gemini | Closed-source | ~18.4% |
| Mistral | Open-source | ~23.9% |
| Llama 3 | Open-source | ~26.3% |
| Gemma | Open-source | ~28.7% |

### Target Variable / Variável Alvo

| Value | Meaning EN | Meaning PT |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Correct response | Resposta correta |
| 1 | Hallucinated response | Resposta alucinada |

### Data Leakage Prevention / Prevenção de Vazamento de Dados

Columns excluded from features / Colunas excluídas das features:
- `n_models_hallucinated`
- `hallucination_type`
- `hallucinated_span`
- `severity`
- `annotation_confidence`

> Train/test split performed by `prompt_id` group — not randomly by row.  
> Divisão treino/teste realizada por grupo de `prompt_id` — não aleatoriamente por linha.

## 📓 Notebooks <a name="notebooks"></a>

| Notebook | Description EN | Descrição PT |
|---|---|---|
| NB1 | EDA + NLP Preprocessing | EDA + Pré-processamento NLP |
| NB2 | LDA + LSA + KMeans + t-SNE | Modelagem de Tópicos + Clustering |
| NB3 | Supervised ML — Hallucination Detection | ML Supervisionado — Detecção de Alucinações |

### NB1 — EDA + NLP Preprocessing
- Dataset summary and missing values
- Target distributions
- Hallucination rate per model, domain and difficulty
- Text length analysis
- NLP pipeline: lowercase → regex → tokenize → stopwords → lemmatize
- Word clouds for prompts and hallucinated spans
- Correlation matrix

### NB2 — Topic Modeling
- LDA coherence search for optimal number of topics
- LDA topic sentences and word clouds
- LSA via TF-IDF + TruncatedSVD
- KMeans clustering on LDA topic distributions
- Elbow + Silhouette for optimal k
- PCA 2D and t-SNE visualizations
- LDA and KMeans metrics

### NB3 — Machine Learning
- Wide to long format transformation
- Group split by `prompt_id`
- 5 experiments across 2 scenarios
- 10 ML models per experiment
- SHAP feature importance
- ROC curves, confusion matrices, classification reports
- 8 business questions answered with data analysis

## 🤖 Models / Modelos <a name="models"></a>

| Model | Experiment | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Naive Bayes | Exp 1, 2 | Simple NLP baseline |
| Complement Naive Bayes | Exp 1, 2 | Best for imbalanced text |
| Logistic Regression | Exp 1, 2 | Strong TF-IDF baseline |
| SGD Classifier | Exp 1, 2 | Fast linear model |
| Linear SVM | Exp 1, 2 | Strong linear text classifier |
| Random Forest | Exp 1, 2 | Tabular + LSA features |
| Extra Trees | Exp 1, 2 | Faster than Random Forest |
| Gradient Boosting | Exp 1, 2 | Strong tabular model |
| LightGBM | Exp 1, 2 | Best gradient boosting |
| MLP | Exp 1, 2 | Neural baseline |

## 📈 Results / Resultados <a name="results"></a>

### Experiment 1 — Prompt Text Only / Experimento 1 — Apenas Texto do Prompt

| Model | Accuracy | F1 Class 1 | Recall Class 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Complement Naive Bayes | 0.5696 | **0.4121** | **0.6959** |
| Linear SVM | 0.5813 | 0.4102 | 0.6720 |
| LightGBM | 0.5813 | 0.4102 | 0.6720 |
| Naive Bayes | 0.7284 | 0.3611 | 0.3541 |
| Gradient Boosting | **0.7833** | 0.0000 | 0.0000 |

> Prompt text alone carries weak predictive signal — the same prompt was answered differently by each model.  
> O texto do prompt sozinho tem sinal preditivo fraco — o mesmo prompt foi respondido de forma diferente por cada modelo.

### Key Metrics / Métricas Principais

| Metric | Priority | Reason EN | Razão PT |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 Class 1 | ⭐⭐⭐ | Primary metric | Métrica principal |
| Recall Class 1 | ⭐⭐⭐ | Minimize missed hallucinations | Minimizar alucinações perdidas |
| PR-AUC | ⭐⭐ | Handles class imbalance | Lida com desbalanceamento |
| ROC-AUC | ⭐⭐ | Overall separation | Separação geral |

## 🚀 Usage / Uso <a name="usage"></a>

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("data/llm_hallucination_benchmark_v2_research_grade.csv", keep_default_na=False)
```

> Run notebooks in order: NB1 → NB2 → NB3.  
> Each notebook saves `.parquet` files consumed by the next.  
> Execute os notebooks em ordem. Cada notebook salva arquivos `.parquet` consumidos pelo próximo.
